name: LayeredProcessAudit
tagline: Plan, run and track layered process audits across every layer and area.
description: A PCF board for manufacturing LPA programmes: schedule matrix by layer and area, question rotation, audit execution with findings, containment and closure, and completion, on-time and conformance KPIs. Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Layer × area schedule matrix with status, score and NC counts
Question rotation with always-asked critical questions
Audit runner with Yes/No/N/A, on-the-spot fixes and findings
Findings lifecycle: open, contained, closed, overdue
Phone card layout, keyboard and ARIA support
JSON in/out, OnChange outputs and browser event
